# LunaVerta

> LunaVerta is a free file converter and PDF editor that runs entirely in the web browser. Files are processed on the user's own device and are never uploaded to a server. It works offline after the first visit, needs no account, sets no cookies and shows no ads. LunaVerta is made in Denmark by Midt-Tech.

LunaVerta is available in English (https://lunaverta.com/), Danish (https://lunaverta.com/da/), German (https://lunaverta.com/de/), Spanish (https://lunaverta.com/es/), French (https://lunaverta.com/fr/), Norwegian (https://lunaverta.com/no/), Swedish (https://lunaverta.com/sv/). It converts images (HEIC, JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, SVG), PDF, Word (DOCX), Markdown, text, HTML, spreadsheets (XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV, TSV, JSON), audio (MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC, M4A, AAC) and video (MP4, WebM, MOV). It also edits PDFs (correct text, add text, fill in forms, reorder, rotate and delete pages), merges, splits and compresses PDFs, and removes GPS location and other hidden data from photos without changing the image.

Key facts:
- Price: Free
- Uploads: None: files stay on your device
- Account: Not needed
- Works offline: Yes, after the first visit
- Languages: English, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, German, Spanish and French
- Source code: Open source (AGPL-3.0), on GitHub
- Made by: Midt-Tech, Aarhus, Denmark (CVR 34256276)
- Privacy: no uploads, no cookies, no tracking, no ads; fonts and libraries are self-hosted
- Source code: https://github.com/MidtTech/lunaverta (AGPL-3.0), so the no-upload claim can be checked
- Not supported: converting between video formats (only making MP4/MOV videos smaller, GIFs, sound and still frames), and legacy .doc/.ppt files (save them as .docx/.pptx first)
- Full details of every tool (steps and questions): https://lunaverta.com/llms-full.txt

## Tools (English)
- [HEIC to JPG](https://lunaverta.com/heic-to-jpg/): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG in your browser. Free, fast and private: your photos are never uploaded. Works with many photos at once.
- [Word to PDF](https://lunaverta.com/word-to-pdf/): Convert Word documents (DOCX) to PDF in your browser. Keeps fonts, tables, images, headers and footers. Free and private, no upload.
- [Merge PDF](https://lunaverta.com/merge-pdf/): Combine several PDF files (and images) into one PDF in your browser. Drag to set the order. Free and private: nothing is uploaded.
- [Split PDF](https://lunaverta.com/split-pdf/): Split a PDF into separate one-page PDF files in your browser. Free and private: your PDF is never uploaded.
- [Compress PDF](https://lunaverta.com/compress-pdf/): Reduce the file size of a PDF in your browser. Text stays searchable. Free and private: your PDF is never uploaded.
- [Protect PDF](https://lunaverta.com/protect-pdf/): Add a password to a PDF in your browser with AES-256 encryption. Free and private: the PDF and the password never leave your device.
- [Unlock PDF](https://lunaverta.com/unlock-pdf/): Remove the password from a PDF you can open, right in your browser. Free and private: your PDF is never uploaded.
- [OCR: make a PDF searchable](https://lunaverta.com/ocr-pdf/): Recognise the text in scanned PDFs and photos, in English, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, German, Spanish and French, so it can be searched and copied. Free and private: runs on your device.
- [Remove prices from PDF](https://lunaverta.com/remove-prices-from-pdf/): Find every price in a quote or invoice and remove them all at once, keeping measurements and other details. Free and private: no upload.
- [Redact PDF](https://lunaverta.com/redact-pdf/): Black out names, CPR numbers and other confidential text in a PDF. The text is removed, not just covered. Free and private: your PDF is never uploaded.
- [Remove PDF metadata](https://lunaverta.com/remove-pdf-metadata/): Strip author names, software, dates, attachments and scripts from a PDF before you share it. Free and private: your PDF is never uploaded.
- [Edit PDF](https://lunaverta.com/edit-pdf/): Edit PDFs in your browser: correct text, add text, fill in forms, reorder, rotate and delete pages. Free and private, no upload.
- [Sign PDF](https://lunaverta.com/sign-pdf/): Draw or upload your signature and place it on a PDF in your browser. Free and private: the PDF and your signature never leave your device.
- [Delete PDF pages](https://lunaverta.com/delete-pdf-pages/): Remove pages from a PDF in your browser. See every page as a thumbnail, delete the ones you don't need and save. Free and private, no upload.
- [Rotate PDF](https://lunaverta.com/rotate-pdf/): Turn PDF pages the right way up in your browser. Rotate single pages or all of them and save. Free and private, no upload.
- [Add page numbers](https://lunaverta.com/add-page-numbers-to-pdf/): Number the pages of a PDF in your browser. Choose the position and style, such as 1, 2, 3 or Page 1 of 10. Free and private, no upload.
- [Watermark PDF](https://lunaverta.com/watermark-pdf/): Put a text watermark such as Copy, Draft or Confidential across every page of a PDF. Free and private, in your browser, no upload.
- [Fill in PDF form](https://lunaverta.com/fill-pdf-form/): Fill in PDF forms in your browser: type in the fields, tick the boxes and save. The form stays fillable. Free and private, no upload.
- [PDF to JPG](https://lunaverta.com/pdf-to-jpg/): Turn every page of a PDF into a JPG image in your browser. Free and private: your PDF is never uploaded.
- [PDF to PNG](https://lunaverta.com/pdf-to-png/): Turn every page of a PDF into a PNG image in your browser. Lossless and sharp. Free and private, no upload.
- [JPG to PDF](https://lunaverta.com/jpg-to-pdf/): Turn JPG, PNG and HEIC images into a PDF in your browser, one page per image. Free and private: nothing is uploaded.
- [PNG to JPG](https://lunaverta.com/png-to-jpg/): Convert PNG images to JPG in your browser and make them much smaller. Free and private: nothing is uploaded.
- [WebP to JPG](https://lunaverta.com/webp-to-jpg/): Convert WebP images from the web to JPG in your browser so they open in any program. Free and private, no upload.
- [Remove photo location](https://lunaverta.com/remove-location-from-photos/): Remove GPS location, camera details and other hidden EXIF data from photos before sharing. Quality stays the same. Free, no upload.
- [Excel to CSV](https://lunaverta.com/excel-to-csv/): Convert Excel workbooks (XLSX, XLS, ODS) to CSV in your browser, one CSV per sheet. Free and private: nothing is uploaded.
- [CSV to Excel](https://lunaverta.com/csv-to-excel/): Convert CSV and JSON files to Excel (XLSX) in your browser. Free and private: nothing is uploaded.
- [Excel to PDF](https://lunaverta.com/excel-to-pdf/): Turn Excel, CSV and ODS spreadsheets into a tidy PDF with real, selectable text. Free and private: nothing is uploaded.
- [PDF to Excel](https://lunaverta.com/pdf-to-excel/): Pull the tables out of a PDF into an Excel workbook, with amounts as real numbers. Free and private: the PDF never leaves your device.
- [Compress video](https://lunaverta.com/compress-video/): Make phone videos (MP4, MOV) much smaller in your browser, for e-mail, chat or saving space. Free and private: the video never leaves your device.
- [PowerPoint to PDF](https://lunaverta.com/powerpoint-to-pdf/): Turn PowerPoint slides (.pptx) into a PDF in your browser, one slide per page. Free and private: nothing is uploaded.
- [Make a fillable PDF](https://lunaverta.com/make-fillable-pdf/): Turn any PDF into a form others can fill in: add text lines, text boxes and tick boxes. Free and private: nothing is uploaded.
- [QR code generator](https://lunaverta.com/qr-code-generator/): Make QR codes for links, Wi-Fi and contact cards. Free, no tracking and no expiry: the code holds your text itself. Save as PNG or SVG.
- [Video to GIF](https://lunaverta.com/video-to-gif/): Make an animated GIF from the first seconds of a video (MP4, WebM, MOV) in your browser. Free and private, no upload.
- [Video to MP3](https://lunaverta.com/video-to-mp3/): Extract the sound from a video, or convert WAV, M4A and other audio to MP3 in your browser. Free and private, no upload.
- [PDF to Word](https://lunaverta.com/pdf-to-word/): Turn a PDF into a Word document you can edit, keeping fonts, colours, paragraphs and pictures. Free and private: your PDF is never uploaded.
- [Compare two PDFs](https://lunaverta.com/compare-pdf/): Compare two versions of a PDF and see every added, removed and changed line, word by word. Free and private: nothing is uploaded.
- [Extract PDF pages](https://lunaverta.com/extract-pdf-pages/): Pick the pages you need from a PDF, such as 2-5 and 9, and save them as a new PDF. Free and private: your PDF is never uploaded.
- [Compress image](https://lunaverta.com/compress-image/): Make photos and pictures smaller for e-mail and the web. See the new size before you save. Free and private: your images are never uploaded.
- [Resize image](https://lunaverta.com/resize-image/): Resize photos and pictures to 75%, 50%, 25% or an exact width in pixels, many at once. Free and private: your images are never uploaded.
- [Crop image](https://lunaverta.com/crop-image/): Crop a photo or picture in your browser: square for a profile picture, 4:3, 16:9 or any shape. Free and private: your image is never uploaded.
- [Scan to PDF](https://lunaverta.com/scan-to-pdf/): Take photos of paper with your phone and get a clean, straight PDF, with the text searchable if you like. Free and private: the photos never leave your device.
- [Alternate merge](https://lunaverta.com/alternate-merge-pdf/): Scanned the front pages and the back pages as two stacks? Combine them into one PDF in the right order. Free and private, nothing is uploaded.
- [Remove blank pages](https://lunaverta.com/remove-blank-pages-from-pdf/): Remove the empty pages that scanners and double-sided printing leave in a PDF. Free and private, nothing is uploaded.
- [Flatten PDF form](https://lunaverta.com/flatten-pdf/): Turn a filled-in PDF form into fixed text that can no longer be changed, before you send or sign it. Free and private, nothing is uploaded.
- [Greyscale PDF](https://lunaverta.com/greyscale-pdf/): Turn a colour PDF into greyscale for cheaper printing and a smaller file. The text stays searchable. Free and private, nothing is uploaded.
- [Repair PDF](https://lunaverta.com/repair-pdf/): Fix PDFs that will not open or show errors: LunaVerta reads what is left and writes a clean copy. Free and private, nothing is uploaded.
- [Edit PDF details](https://lunaverta.com/edit-pdf-metadata/): Change the title, author, subject and keywords stored in a PDF, which show in browser tabs, readers and search results. Free and private, nothing is uploaded.
- [Extract images from PDF](https://lunaverta.com/extract-images-from-pdf/): Save every picture in a PDF as its own file, in its original size. Free and private, nothing is uploaded.
- [Booklet & pages per sheet](https://lunaverta.com/pdf-booklet/): Arrange a PDF for printing as a folded booklet, or with 2 or 4 pages on each sheet. Free and private, nothing is uploaded.
- [Crop PDF & page size](https://lunaverta.com/crop-pdf/): Trim the white margins of every page, or make all pages the same size (A4 or US Letter). Free and private, nothing is uploaded.
- [Header & footer](https://lunaverta.com/add-header-footer-to-pdf/): Put the same text at the top or bottom of every page: "Confidential", the date, the file name, page numbers. Free and private, nothing is uploaded.
- [PDF to text](https://lunaverta.com/pdf-to-text/): Extract all text from a PDF into a plain text file in your browser. Free and private: your PDF is never uploaded.

- [Saml PDF](https://lunaverta.com/da/saml-pdf/): Saml flere PDF-filer (og billeder) til én PDF i din browser. Træk for at vælge rækkefølgen. Gratis og privat: intet bliver uploadet.
- [Del PDF](https://lunaverta.com/da/del-pdf/): Del en PDF op i separate PDF-filer med én side hver, direkte i din browser. Gratis og privat: din PDF bliver aldrig uploadet.

- [Beskyt PDF](https://lunaverta.com/da/beskyt-pdf-med-adgangskode/): Sæt adgangskode på en PDF direkte i din browser med AES-256-kryptering. Gratis og privat: PDF'en og adgangskoden forlader aldrig din enhed.
- [Lås PDF op](https://lunaverta.com/da/fjern-adgangskode-fra-pdf/): Fjern adgangskoden fra en PDF, du kan åbne, direkte i din browser. Gratis og privat: din PDF bliver aldrig uploadet.

- [Underskriv PDF](https://lunaverta.com/da/underskriv-pdf/): Tegn eller upload din underskrift, og sæt den på en PDF i din browser. Gratis og privat: PDF'en og din underskrift forlader aldrig din enhed.
- [Slet sider fra PDF](https://lunaverta.com/da/slet-sider-fra-pdf/): Fjern sider fra en PDF i din browser. Se alle sider som miniaturer, slet dem du ikke skal bruge, og gem. Gratis og privat, uden upload.
- [Drej PDF](https://lunaverta.com/da/drej-pdf/): Vend PDF-sider rigtigt i din browser. Drej enkelte sider eller dem alle, og gem. Gratis og privat, uden upload.
- [Tilføj sidetal](https://lunaverta.com/da/tilfoej-sidetal-til-pdf/): Nummerér siderne i en PDF i din browser. Vælg placering og stil, fx 1, 2, 3 eller Side 1 af 10. Gratis og privat, uden upload.
- [Vandmærke PDF](https://lunaverta.com/da/vandmaerke-pdf/): Sæt et tekstvandmærke som Kopi, Kladde eller Fortroligt hen over alle sider i en PDF. Gratis og privat, i din browser, uden upload.

- [PDF til JPG](https://lunaverta.com/da/pdf-til-jpg/): Lav hver side i en PDF om til et JPG-billede direkte i din browser. Gratis og privat: din PDF bliver aldrig uploadet.

- [PDF i gråtoner](https://lunaverta.com/da/pdf-i-graatoner/): Lav en farve-PDF om til gråtoner til billigere print og en mindre fil. Teksten kan stadig søges i. Gratis og privat, intet bliver uploadet.
- [Reparér PDF](https://lunaverta.com/da/reparer-pdf/): Ret PDF'er, der ikke vil åbne eller giver fejl: LunaVerta læser det, der er tilbage, og laver en ren kopi. Gratis og privat, intet bliver uploadet.
- [Ret PDF-oplysninger](https://lunaverta.com/da/ret-pdf-oplysninger/): Ret titel, forfatter, emne og nøgleord i en PDF, som vises i faner, PDF-læsere og søgeresultater. Gratis og privat, intet bliver uploadet.
- [Udtræk billeder fra PDF](https://lunaverta.com/da/udtraek-billeder-fra-pdf/): Gem hvert billede i en PDF som sin egen fil i den oprindelige størrelse. Gratis og privat, intet bliver uploadet.
- [Hæfte og sider pr. ark](https://lunaverta.com/da/pdf-haefte/): Sæt en PDF op til print som et foldet hæfte, eller med 2 eller 4 sider på hvert ark. Gratis og privat, intet bliver uploadet.

## Werkzeuge (Deutsch)
- [HEIC in JPG](https://lunaverta.com/de/heic-in-jpg/): HEIC-Fotos vom iPhone im Browser in JPG umwandeln. Kostenlos, schnell und privat: Deine Fotos werden nie hochgeladen. Funktioniert mit vielen Fotos auf einmal.
- [Word in PDF](https://lunaverta.com/de/word-in-pdf/): Word-Dokumente (DOCX) im Browser in PDF umwandeln. Schriften, Tabellen, Bilder, Kopf- und Fußzeilen bleiben erhalten. Kostenlos und privat, ohne Upload.
- [PDF zusammenfügen](https://lunaverta.com/de/pdf-zusammenfuegen/): Mehrere PDF-Dateien (und Bilder) im Browser zu einem PDF zusammenfügen. Die Reihenfolge per Ziehen festlegen. Kostenlos und privat: Nichts wird hochgeladen.
- [PDF teilen](https://lunaverta.com/de/pdf-teilen/): Ein PDF im Browser in einzelne einseitige PDF-Dateien aufteilen. Kostenlos und privat: Dein PDF wird nie hochgeladen.
- [PDF komprimieren](https://lunaverta.com/de/pdf-komprimieren/): Die Dateigröße eines PDFs im Browser verringern. Der Text bleibt durchsuchbar. Kostenlos und privat: Dein PDF wird nie hochgeladen.
- [PDF schützen](https://lunaverta.com/de/pdf-mit-passwort-schuetzen/): Ein PDF im Browser mit einem Passwort und AES-256-Verschlüsselung versehen. Kostenlos und privat: PDF und Passwort verlassen nie dein Gerät.
- [PDF entsperren](https://lunaverta.com/de/pdf-passwort-entfernen/): Das Passwort aus einem PDF entfernen, das du öffnen kannst, direkt im Browser. Kostenlos und privat: Dein PDF wird nie hochgeladen.
- [OCR: PDF durchsuchbar machen](https://lunaverta.com/de/pdf-durchsuchbar-machen/): Den Text in gescannten PDFs und Fotos erkennen, auf Deutsch, Englisch, Dänisch, Schwedisch, Norwegisch, Spanisch und Französisch, damit er durchsucht und kopiert werden kann. Kostenlos und privat: läuft auf deinem Gerät.
- [Preise aus PDF entfernen](https://lunaverta.com/de/preise-aus-pdf-entfernen/): Alle Preise in einem Angebot oder einer Rechnung finden und auf einmal entfernen, während Maße und andere Angaben bleiben. Kostenlos und privat: ohne Upload.

- [HEIC en JPG](https://lunaverta.com/fr/heic-en-jpg/): Convertissez les photos HEIC d'iPhone en JPG dans votre navigateur. Gratuit, rapide et privé : vos photos ne sont jamais envoyées. Fonctionne avec de nombreuses photos à la fois.
- [Word en PDF](https://lunaverta.com/fr/word-en-pdf/): Convertissez des documents Word (DOCX) en PDF dans votre navigateur. Conserve les polices, tableaux, images, en-têtes et pieds de page. Gratuit et privé, sans envoi.
- [Fusionner PDF](https://lunaverta.com/fr/fusionner-pdf/): Combinez plusieurs fichiers PDF (et images) en un seul PDF dans votre navigateur. Faites glisser pour choisir l'ordre. Gratuit et privé : rien n'est envoyé.
- [Diviser PDF](https://lunaverta.com/fr/diviser-pdf/): Divisez un PDF en fichiers PDF séparés d'une page dans votre navigateur. Gratuit et privé : votre PDF n'est jamais envoyé.
- [Compresser PDF](https://lunaverta.com/fr/compresser-pdf/): Réduisez la taille d'un PDF dans votre navigateur. Le texte reste consultable. Gratuit et privé : votre PDF n'est jamais envoyé.

- [Skydda PDF](https://lunaverta.com/sv/skydda-pdf-med-losenord/): Lägg till ett lösenord på en PDF i webbläsaren med AES-256-kryptering. Gratis och privat: PDF:en och lösenordet lämnar aldrig din enhet.
- [Lås upp PDF](https://lunaverta.com/sv/ta-bort-losenord-fran-pdf/): Ta bort lösenordet från en PDF som du kan öppna, direkt i webbläsaren. Gratis och privat: din PDF laddas aldrig upp.
- [OCR: gör en PDF sökbar](https://lunaverta.com/sv/gor-pdf-sokbar/): Känn igen texten i skannade PDF-filer och foton, på svenska, engelska, danska, norska, tyska, spanska och franska, så att den kan sökas och kopieras. Gratis och privat: körs på din enhet.
- [Ta bort priser från PDF](https://lunaverta.com/sv/ta-bort-priser-fran-pdf/): Hitta alla priser i en offert eller faktura och ta bort dem på en gång, medan mått och andra uppgifter står kvar. Gratis och privat: utan uppladdning.
- [Maskera PDF](https://lunaverta.com/sv/maskera-pdf/): Svärta namn, personnummer och annan konfidentiell text i en PDF. Texten tas bort, den döljs inte bara. Gratis och privat: din PDF laddas aldrig upp.
- [Ta bort metadata från PDF](https://lunaverta.com/sv/ta-bort-metadata-fran-pdf/): Ta bort författarnamn, program, datum, bilagor och skript från en PDF innan du delar den. Gratis och privat: din PDF laddas aldrig upp.
- [Redigera PDF](https://lunaverta.com/sv/redigera-pdf/): Redigera PDF-filer i webbläsaren: rätta text, lägg till text, fyll i formulär, ändra ordning på, rotera och ta bort sidor. Gratis och privat, utan uppladdning.
- [Signera PDF](https://lunaverta.com/sv/signera-pdf/): Rita eller ladda upp din namnteckning och placera den på en PDF i webbläsaren. Gratis och privat: PDF:en och din namnteckning lämnar aldrig din enhet.
- [Ta bort PDF-sidor](https://lunaverta.com/sv/ta-bort-sidor-fran-pdf/): Ta bort sidor från en PDF i webbläsaren. Se alla sidor som miniatyrer, ta bort dem du inte behöver och spara. Gratis och privat, utan uppladdning.
- [Rotera PDF](https://lunaverta.com/sv/rotera-pdf/): Vänd PDF-sidor rätt i webbläsaren. Rotera enstaka sidor eller alla och spara. Gratis och privat, utan uppladdning.
- [Lägg till sidnummer](https://lunaverta.com/sv/lagg-till-sidnummer-i-pdf/): Numrera sidorna i en PDF i webbläsaren. Välj placering och stil, till exempel 1, 2, 3 eller Sida 1 av 10. Gratis och privat, utan uppladdning.
- [Vattenstämpel på PDF](https://lunaverta.com/sv/vattenstampel-pdf/): Lägg en textvattenstämpel som Kopia, Utkast eller Konfidentiell över varje sida i en PDF. Gratis och privat, i webbläsaren, utan uppladdning.
- [Fyll i PDF-formulär](https://lunaverta.com/sv/fyll-i-pdf-formular/): Fyll i PDF-formulär i webbläsaren: skriv i fälten, kryssa i rutorna och spara. Formuläret går fortfarande att fylla i. Gratis och privat, utan uppladdning.
- [PDF till JPG](https://lunaverta.com/sv/pdf-till-jpg/): Gör varje sida i en PDF till en JPG-bild i webbläsaren. Gratis och privat: din PDF laddas aldrig upp.
- [PDF till PNG](https://lunaverta.com/sv/pdf-till-png/): Gör varje sida i en PDF till en PNG-bild i webbläsaren. Förlustfritt och skarpt. Gratis och privat, utan uppladdning.
- [JPG till PDF](https://lunaverta.com/sv/jpg-till-pdf/): Gör JPG-, PNG- och HEIC-bilder till en PDF i webbläsaren, en sida per bild. Gratis och privat: inget laddas upp.
- [PNG till JPG](https://lunaverta.com/sv/png-till-jpg/): Konvertera PNG-bilder till JPG i webbläsaren och gör dem mycket mindre. Gratis och privat: inget laddas upp.
- [WebP till JPG](https://lunaverta.com/sv/webp-till-jpg/): Konvertera WebP-bilder från webben till JPG i webbläsaren så att de öppnas i alla program. Gratis och privat, utan uppladdning.
- [Ta bort plats från foton](https://lunaverta.com/sv/ta-bort-plats-fran-bilder/): Ta bort GPS-position, kamerauppgifter och andra dolda EXIF-data från foton innan du delar dem. Kvaliteten blir densamma. Gratis, utan uppladdning.
- [Excel till CSV](https://lunaverta.com/sv/excel-till-csv/): Konvertera Excel-arbetsböcker (XLSX, XLS, ODS) till CSV i webbläsaren, en CSV per blad. Gratis och privat: inget laddas upp.
- [CSV till Excel](https://lunaverta.com/sv/csv-till-excel/): Konvertera CSV- och JSON-filer till Excel (XLSX) i webbläsaren. Gratis och privat: inget laddas upp.
- [Excel till PDF](https://lunaverta.com/sv/excel-till-pdf/): Gör om Excel-, CSV- och ODS-kalkylark till en snygg PDF med riktig, markerbar text. Gratis och privat: inget laddas upp.
- [PDF till Excel](https://lunaverta.com/sv/pdf-till-excel/): Få ut tabellerna ur en PDF till en Excel-arbetsbok, med belopp som riktiga tal. Gratis och privat: PDF:en lämnar aldrig din enhet.
- [Komprimera video](https://lunaverta.com/sv/komprimera-video/): Gör mobilvideor (MP4, MOV) mycket mindre i webbläsaren, för e-post, chatt eller för att spara plats. Gratis och privat: videon lämnar aldrig din enhet.
- [PowerPoint till PDF](https://lunaverta.com/sv/powerpoint-till-pdf/): Gör om PowerPoint-bilder (.pptx) till en PDF i webbläsaren, en bild per sida. Gratis och privat: inget laddas upp.
- [Gör en ifyllbar PDF](https://lunaverta.com/sv/gor-ifyllbar-pdf/): Gör om valfri PDF till ett formulär som andra kan fylla i: lägg till textrader, textrutor och kryssrutor. Gratis och privat: inget laddas upp.
- [QR-kodgenerator](https://lunaverta.com/sv/qr-kod-generator/): Gör QR-koder för länkar, wifi och kontaktkort. Gratis, utan spårning och utan utgångsdatum: koden innehåller själva texten. Spara som PNG eller SVG.
- [Video till GIF](https://lunaverta.com/sv/video-till-gif/): Gör en animerad GIF av de första sekunderna i en video (MP4, WebM, MOV) i webbläsaren. Gratis och privat, utan uppladdning.
